stick_electromagnetism_and_geometry.statement: Maxwell's equations are geometry. The field is a 2-form F: dF = 0 and d*F = J are the whole theory in two lines of exterior calculus. The inverse square is the sphere; c falls out of the vacuum's two constants; the vacuum has an impedance; and the invariance of that c forced the geometry of spacetime itself - E and B are one tensor, mixed by a boost.

ticks.claim: [c falls out of the vacuum's two constants] Maxwell computed the speed of his waves from two laboratory constants and found light: 1/sqrt(mu0 eps0) = 299792458 m/s (sealed), which is c = 299,792,458 m/s to the precision of the listed values. In the 2018 SI eps0 is DEFINED through mu0 and c, so the circle closes exactly - not a coincidence, a geometry: light is the vacuum's own ratio.

[the inverse square IS the sphere] Double the distance from a charge and the field falls to (1/2)^2 = 0.25 (sealed) - because the flux through a closed surface is conserved and a sphere's area is 4 pi r^2. Gauss's law is not a separate fact about charge; it is the geometry of three-dimensional space. The 4 pi in alpha = e^2 / (4 pi eps0 hbar c) is this same sphere (the alpha stick).

[the vacuum has a shape] sqrt(mu0 / eps0) = 376.730314 ohm (sealed) - the impedance of free space, the fixed ratio of E to H in every plane wave. It is the number every transmission line and the Smith chart normalize against (the smith_chart stick): the Mobius geometry of reflection is measured from this one point.

[EM forced the geometry of spacetime] Maxwell's c is the same in every frame; the only geometry that keeps it so is Lorentz/Minkowski. At v = 0.6c, gamma = 1 / sqrt(1 - 0.36) = 1.25 (sealed). E and B are not two fields but one antisymmetric tensor F_mu_nu; a boost mixes them, as a rotation mixes x and y. Relativity was not added to electromagnetism - it was found inside it.

[Maxwell IS geometry - the full map] F = dA: the field is the curvature of a U(1) connection A. dF = 0 (Faraday's law + no magnetic monopoles) and d*F = J (Ampere-Maxwell + Gauss) are the entire theory - div and curl (the vector_calculus stick) are its native operators, and Faraday's lines of force were the first physical field drawn as geometry rather than action at a distance. Maxwell's displacement current was added by thought, not experiment, because the geometry demanded closure: without it there are no waves. The Aharonov-Bohm phase (the aharonov_bohm stick) is the holonomy of A around a loop - pure geometry, a phase with no force on the path. The Poynting vector S = E x B is an oriented area.
